title: Quenchy Cactus
description: It'll Quench Ya! Drink cactus juice directly, or brew cactus into potions with rainbow vision effects. Mind-Melting variant too
body:
It it not recommended to use this mod if you have epilepsy. Flashing Lights.
# Cactus Juice 
## How to Get Cactus Juice

Craft it: Put 1 Cactus + 1 Bowl in a crafting table.

 Or just right-click a cactus with an empty bowl.

![Replace this with a description](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/80a0f13902f1f8ff2f8561355667cbe417be2bcb_0.webp)

Eat it for a quick 30-second buzz and some buffs.
## How to Brew Cactus Potions
## 
Use a Brewing Stand:

Cactus Juice Potion3m =	  Awkward Potion + Cactus 

Extended 8m =	        Cactus Juice Potion + Redstone 

Mind-Melting3m =    Cactus Juice Potion + Glowstone Dust 	

 

 

 

Splash version: Add Gunpowder to any potion.

Lingering version: Add Dragon's Breath to a splash potion.


## What the Potions Do
## 

All potions give you buffs: Night Vision, Speed, Strength, Jump Boost, Haste, Regeneration, Slow Falling, and Dolphin's Grace.


Your screen gets a rainbow overlay — shifting colors, pulsing rings, and flowing patterns. It's vivid but you can still see and play through it unless you brew the cactus into the mind-melting potion!


## The Mind-Melting Potion 
## 

This one's different. When you drink it, you get an 8-second trip: your screen goes dark and erupts with spinning kaleidoscope patterns, fractal stars collapsing inward, geometric shapes folding toward center, and a hyperspace tunnel effect. After the trip, the regular rainbow overlay kicks in for the rest of the duration.


When someone brews a Mind-Melting potion, anyone nearby gets a chat warning
## JEII


All items and potions show up in JEI with recipes and descriptions. Look them up there if you forget.
